clip_shape.deviation: EVAL_PLAN section 4 designs 6 s clips as 2 s calm, 2 s test, 2 s calm. These are 3 s as 1 s calm and 2 s test, so that about three thousand clips fit in one session. Logged in eval/DEVIATIONS.md. The trailing calm section is gone, so this suite does not measure how long a hide runs on past the flashing.
